company_name: KAWASAKI HEAVY INDUSTRIES, LTD. TAIPEI BRANCH (JAPAN)
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Ltd. specializes in robotics and automation, which can support semiconductor manufacturing processes but is not primarily a semiconductor supplier.
summary: Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of industrial robots and robot systems, providing solutions that enhance automation in various industries, including semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include comprehensive support from installation to training and operation, with a focus on minimizing downtime through advanced technologies.
capabilities: M2M and IoT technologies for preventative maintenance

regional_presence.Taiwan: Kawasaki has a branch in Taipei, focusing on providing robotics solutions in the region.
